answer: Sybil resistance is guaranteed by binding each node identity to an attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE). Adversaries cannot flood the state with an ocean of cheap virtual clones; identity replication demands procurement of discrete physical silicon rather than ephemeral machine duplication. This root-of-trust anchors our network like a secure harbor, cultivating a resilient grove of verifiable execution environments where cryptographic attestation precludes state capture.
